description: This file defines React components for displaying product information in a furniture marketplace frontend. It includes the ProductCard component for individual product display and ProductGrid for rendering a grid of products.

methods.name: ProductCard
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a product card with image, title, description, price, and add to cart button.

methods.name: ProductGrid
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a grid layout of multiple ProductCard components.
